system.description:
| Infectious Acidic Blood - Infections. / Filth Fever. A raging fever sweeps through the creature’s body. The creature has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity based checks, saving throws, and attack rolls. / Mind Fire. A burning injection of thought and migraines sweeps through the creature’s mind, making it impossible to think clearly. The creature has disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom based checks, saving throws, and attack rolls. / Seizing Doom. The creatures body betrays it, as jitters and ticks overwrite their physical desire to act or mental need to think. The first time each turn the creature would attack to move or take an Action or Bonus Action, they must roll a D20. If they roll below a 12, their body seizes as they fall Prone unable to resist the infection wreaking havoc across their body. / While a creature has any of the above infections, they cannot gain the benefits of a Long rest. A creature can only be cured of these infections if an effect would remove ranks of Weakened or Envenomed of a rank equal to, or greater than the rank Acidic Blood was cast at. |

You begin to generate acidic medical chakra and infuse it into a willing creature within range.

When a willing creature would take bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage before the end of your next turn, their body reacts by ejecting acidic blood. All creatures within 5 feet of the affected creature takes 12 acid damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 4. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can choose to force all creatures who take damage, to make a constitution saving throw. If they fail their save, they are infected with a malignant collection of acidic chakras, resulting in Filth Fever. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, creatures who fail their saving throw can also fall under the effects of Mind Fire in addition to other infections caused by this jutsu. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, creatures who fail their saving throw can also fall under the effects of Seizing Doom.
